data.markdowncontent: Sends each message in the user's My EME chat to that chat's OpenCode session, which works in the user's own workspace folder (WEB-INF/data/<catalog>/workspaces/<userid>/) with the shell, web and outside-folder access turned off, and shows OpenCode's reply. Each chat session (channel) keeps its own OpenCode session in channel.opencodesessionid. For now the reply arrives whole when OpenCode finishes.
Uploads the user's skills and memory files to My EME. Not implemented yet.
Summarizes the user's pending messages into a daily status report. Not implemented yet.
